// MODULE_REGISTRATION.txt — Tenancy / Owner vs Tenant + Voting Rights Matrix
// =============================================================================
// Do NOT edit schema.prisma or app.module.ts directly per task instructions.
// Merge these imports manually (or via the main agent).
// =============================================================================

1) In apps/api/src/app/app.module.ts:
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   import { TenancyModule } from '../tenancy/tenancy.module';
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Add to the `imports: [ ... ]` array (keep alphabetical-ish near UnitsModule / VotesModule):
   ------------------------------------------------------------
     BuildingsModule,
     UnitsModule,
     OwnershipsModule,
     TenancyModule,   // <-- add this
     ExpenseCategoriesModule,
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Or alternatively near VotesModule:
   ------------------------------------------------------------
     VotesModule,
     TenancyModule,   // <-- add this
     JobsModule,
   ------------------------------------------------------------

2) No additional providers, guards, or global pipes required.
   - TenancyModule already imports AuditModule.
   - JwtAuthGuard + RolesGuard are applied per-controller (ADMIN only).
   - ValidationPipe is applied per-controller with { whitelist: true, transform: true }.
   - Global ThrottlerGuard is registered in AuthModule (app-wide) — tenancy routes
     automatically inherit throttling; no extra ThrottlerModule import needed.

3) After merging the Prisma fragment (SCHEMA_ADDITION.prisma):
     pnpm prisma generate
     pnpm prisma migrate dev --name tenancy
   (the migration adds columns to Ownership and creates VotingEligibilityRule)

4) Optional integration in VotesService:
   Inject TenancyService and replace computeTally with computeEligibleTally when
   tenancy matrix is active, e.g.:
     const tally = await this.tenancy.computeEligibleTally(vote.buildingId, vote.id, user);
   No schema change is required for VotesModule — TenancyService is exported.

5) Verify module loads:
     pnpm nx run api:build
     pnpm nx run api:test --testFile="tenancy.service.spec.ts"
